text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. One common approach is supervised learning, where a computer is given training data that includes both examples and the correct answers. The computer uses this data to build models, which are like rules it can follow. After learning from the training data, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model gets the right answer. Better training data usually leads to more accurate predictions.
